title: Shh, Says the Snow
hook: Down comes the snow, and one by one, everyone settles. Even Baby.
blurb: Duck splashes, Lamb skips and Fox pads through the field. Then down comes the snow, soft and quiet, and one by one every animal tucks in. Only Owl stays up, keeping watch. A gentle, rhythmic wind-down for the very youngest listeners, with sounds to join in and a refrain to whisper.
coverAlt: A baby in a cream sleepsuit at a frosty cottage window, palms on the glass, watching big soft snowflakes fall over a farm at dusk while an owl looks on from a tree

narrator.notes: Very soft and slow, almost a lullaby. Animal sounds playful but gentle. Every 'Shh, says the snow' quieter than the line before. Long pauses at the end.

style: Premium contemporary picture-book illustration for babies: soft painterly 3D look, very simple, rounded, chunky shapes, big clear characters with gentle faces, warm lamp-light against deep blue dusk, gentle film grain, uncluttered compositions with lots of soft space, big soft snowflakes. Consistent characters on every page. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, signs or captions anywhere in the image.
world: A small farm in the English countryside at dusk, as the first snow of winter falls. A round duck pond with reeds, a sloping field with a low stone wall, a hawthorn hedge at the field's edge, an old oak tree beside a whitewashed cottage with one warmly lit window. The sky is deep dusky blue; snowflakes are large, soft and slow. Everything gets a little whiter and quieter page by page.

cast.name: Baby
cast.role: A baby, about one year old
cast.look: Baby: a chubby, round-cheeked baby about one year old with deep brown skin, a soft cap of short black curls, big dark eyes and tiny ears. Wears a cream knitted sleepsuit with feet. Sits or stands holding on; never walks freely.

cast.name: Duck
cast.look: Duck: a plump white farm duck with a bright orange beak and orange webbed feet, a little tuft of feathers sticking up on her head, round shiny black eyes. Small and roly-poly.

cast.name: Lamb
cast.role: A young lamb, with her mother
cast.look: Lamb: a small fluffy white lamb with a black face, black knobbly knees and black ears that stick out sideways, very curly wool like popcorn. Her mother is a larger, calm ewe with the same black face and a thick cream fleece.

cast.name: Fox
cast.look: Fox: a slim, gentle red fox with a white chest and white tip on his big bushy tail, black socks on his legs, pointed ears, amber eyes, a calm kind expression. Never fierce.

cast.name: Owl
cast.role: A tawny owl who keeps watch
cast.look: Owl: a round, fluffy tawny owl with mottled brown-and-cream feathers, a pale heart-shaped face, enormous round dark eyes and little feathery tufts. Wise, kind and wide awake.

pages.heading: Down Comes the Snow
pages.text:
The sky is soft and blue and low.

Down comes the snow.

Down, down, down.

It lands on the roofs. It lands on the trees.

Shh, says the snow.

Shh, shh, shh.
pages.imageAlt: Big soft snowflakes drifting down over a little farm at dusk, with a cottage window glowing warm

art.shot: Wide, calm establishing view from the edge of the field.
art.prompt: The first big, soft snowflakes drift down over a small farm at dusk. A whitewashed cottage with one warmly lit window, an old oak tree, a round pond and a sloping field with a low stone wall. No animals in this picture. The sky is deep dusky blue. A thin dusting of white is starting on the roof and branches. Peaceful, hushed and full of wonder. No characters close up.

pages.heading: Duck
pages.text:
Quack, quack! says Duck.

Splish, splash, splosh!

Down comes the snow, soft on Duck's back.

Shh, says the snow.

Duck tucks her beak under her wing.
pages.imageAlt: Duck splashing happily in the pond as snowflakes land on her white back

art.shot: Low, close view at water level, Duck large in the frame.
art.prompt: Duck splashes happily in the round pond, wings out, water droplets flying, beak open in a cheerful quack. Big soft snowflakes land on her white back. Reeds at the pond's edge with a little snow on top. Dusky blue light with a warm glow from the cottage window in the distance. Playful and sweet.

pages.heading: Lamb
pages.text:
Baa, baa! says Lamb.

Hop, skip, jump!

Down comes the snow, soft on Lamb's wool.

Shh, says the snow.

Lamb snuggles in next to her mummy.
pages.imageAlt: Lamb skipping in the snowy field, with her mother lying calmly by the stone wall

art.shot: Medium-wide view across the field, Lamb mid-skip in the foreground.
art.prompt: Lamb skips with all four knobbly black legs off the ground, ears flying, in the sloping field. Snowflakes are caught in her curly wool. Behind her, her mother the ewe lies calmly beside the low stone wall, waiting. The grass is turning white. Joyful, bouncy and gentle, dusk light.

pages.heading: Fox
pages.text:
Fox does not say anything.

Pad, pad, pad.

Down comes the snow, soft on Fox's nose.

Shh, says the snow.

Fox curls up small and wraps his tail round.
pages.imageAlt: Fox padding quietly along the hedge with a snowflake landing on the tip of his nose

art.shot: Side-on view at fox height along the hedge, a little closer than before.
art.prompt: Fox pads quietly along the bottom of the hawthorn hedge, leaving small neat footprints in the thin new snow. A single big snowflake lands on the tip of his nose and he looks at it, cross-eyed and calm. Soft blue dusk, the hedge dusted white. Quiet, curious and gentle, never fierce.

pages.heading: Owl
pages.text:
Hoo, hoo! says Owl.

Owl is wide awake.

Down comes the snow, soft on Owl's tree.

Shh, says the snow.

But Owl stays up. Owl keeps watch.
pages.imageAlt: Owl perched on a snowy branch of the old oak, wide awake, looking out over the quiet farm

art.shot: Looking up at Owl on a branch, the farm small below.
art.prompt: Owl sits on a thick branch of the old oak tree, round and fluffy, enormous eyes wide open, snow collecting on the branch around her. Below, small and far away, the pond with Duck asleep at its edge, the field with Lamb snuggled against her mother, and Fox curled into a ball by the hedge. The cottage window glows warm. Calm, watchful and safe.

pages.heading: At the Window
pages.text:
Who is at the window?

Pat, pat, pat!

Little hands. Little nose. Big eyes, watching the snow.

Down, down, down.

Shh, says the snow.

Yawn, says Baby.
pages.imageAlt: Baby at the cottage window with both hands on the glass, watching the snow fall outside

art.shot: Inside the cosy room, looking past Baby out through the window.
art.prompt: Baby stands holding on to a cushioned window seat inside a warm, lamp-lit cottage room, both chubby palms pressed on the frosty glass, nose almost touching it, eyes wide. Outside, big snowflakes fall past the window and Owl is a small round shape on the oak branch. A soft knitted blanket lies on the window seat. Cosy, wondering and a little sleepy.

pages.heading: Shh
pages.text:
Warm milk. Soft blanket. A kiss on the nose.

Duck is asleep. Lamb is asleep. Fox is asleep.

Owl keeps watch.

And Baby?

Shh, says the snow.

Shh.
pages.imageAlt: Baby fast asleep in a cot in a cosy sleeping bag, with snow falling past the window and Owl watching from the tree

art.shot: Soft, close view over the cot rail, the window beyond.
art.prompt: Baby is fast asleep on their back in a wooden cot, arms up by their head, snug in a soft cream baby sleeping bag, with nothing else in the cot, a gentle smile. A dim night-light glows amber. Through the window behind, snow falls slowly and Owl sits on the oak branch, wide awake, keeping watch. Very dim, soft, low-contrast, peaceful and safe.
